summary: Teardown routine for a large session-side struct. Destroys three linked lists (heads at this+0x1B758, this+0x1B770, this+0x1B780) by walking each node's +4 next pointer and calling DestructorWithDoubleFreePattern, then zeroes each list's four bookkeeping fields (head/next/tail/count). Destroys an array of 104 sub-objects laid out with a 872-byte stride via EmptyStub_0170, then destroys the linked list at this+0x3FC8 with ConditionalDestructor_46f0 and zeroes its four bookkeeping fields, resets the vtable pointer this+0x3FBC to off_59F0CC, and destroys a second array of 104 sub-objects with a 140-byte stride via EmptyStub_0170. Finally frees the two dynamic buffers at this+0xBC and this+0xB4 with FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null and returns the result of EmptyStub_0170(this+52). Called by sub_45BF70 (0045BF70).
